source: William Lilly original Christian Astrology 1647 Wellcome b30338724
title: Number of Brethren
scope: Historical alternative third-house sibling count/sex/survival method and author-attributed Ptolemy disagreement. No empirical fertility or mortality validation.

groups.scope: Printed CXXI heading and third-house sign/lord count premise

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXI Number of Brethren
clauses.meaning_historical_only: A standalone printed CXXI sibling-count rulebook appears on original PDF602 after the sibling-concord chapter on PDF601.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe of the third house ... prolificall
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly treats the third-house sign as a condition for alleged abundance of siblings.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: and his Lord also
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The third-house lord is separately required to be prolific for the strongest large-sibling assertion.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native shall have many
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The combination of prolific third sign and its ruler is asserted to imply many siblings, without empirical demographic verification.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: and so the contrary
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The inverse barren configuration is alleged to imply the contrary but its exact numerical threshold is undefined.

groups.scope: Count candidate siblings through aspecting planets and zodiac sign sex

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: So many Planets as behold the third house or his Lord
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly's unusual counting rule proposes number of qualifying planets aspecting the third house or its lord.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: out of Masculine Signes ... so many Brethren
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Qualifying aspecting planets in masculine zodiac signs are said to indicate brothers; actual sex counts are not measured.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: in feminine Signes ... so many Sisters
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Qualifying planets in feminine zodiac signs are instead assigned as sisters, with no biological validity.

groups.scope: Siblings' survival judged from mutual planetary aspects

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planets that are Significators behold one another
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The author uses mutual aspects between sibling significators rather than their isolated placements to classify survival.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: with good aspects ... shall live
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Favorable intersignificator aspects are alleged to imply sibling survival, not a verified mortality forecast.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: with ill aspect, they dye
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Adverse aspects are asserted to imply deaths of siblings, an unvalidated, particularly high-stakes claim.

groups.scope: Mars combustion, younger sibling mortality, third-lord combustion and Sun configurations

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars Combust
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Combustion of Mars is named as a specific alleged indicator for reduced siblings.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: imports few Brethren
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly links combust Mars to low brother count; no actual birth data are checked.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: death of the younger, if any be
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The author adds an exceptional claim of younger-sibling death conditional on such siblings existing.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the third Combust
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Combust third-house ruler is an alternative to Mars combustion in a later adverse sibling-count clause.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Sun in the third house
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Sun occupying the third is listed as a separate unfavorable condition, not necessarily requiring the third ruler combust.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: or in Opposition of Jupiter
clauses.meaning_historical_only: An opposition with Jupiter appears as another textual alternative, but its original antecedent needs precise review.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: few Brethren ... they will not live long
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The author assigns few siblings and alleged short lives under the cluster of configurations; no verification of mortality.

groups.scope: Saturn or Jupiter at Ascendant and present-born child status

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Jupiter in the first house
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Either of two named planets in the first house is considered in the source's firstborn/relative-survival claim.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: he ... then borne ... either first borne
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The author allows the chart subject to be firstborn under this astrological condition, without birth order evidence.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: or will live best of all the rest
clauses.meaning_historical_only: A favorable life relative to other siblings is an alternative to firstborn status, increasing outcome flexibility.

groups.scope: Angular dignity and superior/inferior planetary alternative

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Sun in any of the Angles
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Saturn or Sun occupying any angular house is another source branch concerning firstborn or highest relative welfare.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: in their Essentiall dignitie
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Essential dignity is a further requirement for the angular-planet option.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the ascendant ... three superior Planets
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The ruler of Ascendant being one of three traditional superior planets starts a separate option.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: and in the third house
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The superior Ascendant ruler must also occupy the third house to fulfill that option.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the third ... inferior Planet
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Third-house ruler being an inferior planet starts a fourth historical branch.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: and in the ascendant
clauses.meaning_historical_only: That inferior third-house ruler must be situated in the first house for the branch to apply.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: either first borne or shall live in best manner
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly again assigns an ambiguous either-or firstborn or best-off sibling result to any of the qualified configurations.

groups.scope: Ptolemy alternate mother/sect eleventh-house method as attributed by Lilly

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Ancients ... quite desert Ptolomey
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly openly notes a disagreement between his method and what he describes as Ptolemy's; not independently source-reconciled.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe of the mid-heaven, being the Mothers house
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The attributed Ptolemaic counting method refers to the Midheaven sign rather than Lilly's third-house starting point.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: diurnally from Venus
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Day-birth Ptolemaic indicator is said by Lilly to be Venus, subject to independent original-source verification.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: nocturnally from Moon
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Night-birth Ptolemaic indicator is said to be Moon, an explicit sect-dependent alternative.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: house succeeding the mid-heaven ... eleventh
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The house following Midheaven, described as the chart's eleventh, supplies another Ptolemaic witness.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Benevolent Planets behold those places
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The attributed Ptolemaic method additionally requires benefic aspects to the selected places.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: we may predict many Brethren
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly quotes or paraphrases Ptolemy as claiming many siblings, not scientifically verified.

groups.scope: Lilly's same-mother interpretation, rejection of Ptolemy and next unnumbered section

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: more Brethren or Sisters by the same Mother
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly proposes that Ptolemy's method may apply narrowly to siblings from the same mother, rather than siblings generally.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: some probability of truth and reason
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The author cautiously grants a possibility under the restricted same-mother interpretation, not a measured probability.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Otherwise the manner I have prescribed
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Lilly says his alternative third-house method should be used outside that maternal-specific scope.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: more generally followed and more rationall
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The author asserts broader acceptance/rationality for his method without supplying comparative blind tests.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Ptolomy stands single ... Greeks Jewes Arabians Latines
clauses.meaning_historical_only: He claims Ptolemy lacked support from other traditions; historical consensus is not established by that assertion alone.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Stultum est absque demonstratione ...
clauses.meaning_historical_only: The closing Latin maxim is preserved as an uncertain period rhetorical appeal rather than quantitative comparison.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Judgments upon the fourth House ... Parents
clauses.meaning_historical_only: A distinct unnumbered substantive fourth-house introduction begins after decorative separator on original PDF603 and must not be counted as CXXI sibling-number text.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators of the Father ... fourth house
clauses.meaning_historical_only: Only the opening of the next source section is included as navigation; its father/parent questions remain unextracted.
